entries.purpose: Static, unpadded reading surface composed from the canonical Card.
constraints: Callers own layout and heading semantics; do not imply interaction with decorative hover treatment.

evidence.scope: Shared pattern contracts; not every consumer or route.

entries.purpose: Section heading with optional decorative icon, description and caller-owned actions.
constraints: Select the heading level appropriate to the surrounding document; nested action groups own their layout.

evidence.scope: Heading composition contracts, not universal heading hierarchy certification.

entries.purpose: Localized loading, empty, error, partial and permission presentation with caller-owned actions.
constraints: Choose a truthful state from domain/query results; the component does not infer authorization or invent missing data.

evidence.scope: Localized variants and action/announcement contracts; not live data or whole-app accessibility.

entries.purpose: Labelled controlled preference switch using the adopted Button.
constraints: Caller owns state and persistence; supply translated label and description. Minimum target treatment is not a whole-app accessibility certificate.

evidence.scope: Preference control/panel contracts with isolated ownership inputs.

entries.purpose: Existing generated Shadcn Button exposed through the application facade.
constraints: Do not hand-edit the generated implementation. Supply an accessible translated label; inspect the shared CSS owners. Not all variants, opacity combinations or consumer overrides are certified.

evidence.scope: Selected semantic/alpha contrast and adoption contracts, not every native attribute or variant rendering.

entries.purpose: Metric tile migrated to finite semantic presentation; consumer and rendered acceptance remain under review.
constraints: The new API removes arbitrary paint/class overrides. Supply domain-owned values and explicit availability; tone must not infer academic classification. Source migration does not certify all consumers or rendered states.

evidence.scope: Migration findings, not approval or browser verification.

entries.purpose: Existing Hawdex card facade retained for active compatibility consumers.
constraints: Do not select as a new default or delete it without consumer evidence. Compatibility status is not a deprecation announcement.

replacement.note: Compare spacing, style and behavior before migrating; no automatic substitution is authorized.

evidence.scope: Current compatibility/import guidance, not approval of every Hawdex implementation.
